gloss: step by step; guiding someone by the hand

definitions.gloss: step by step; teaching in great detail
definitions.explanation: Teaching or guiding someone very carefully, showing every step as if taking the learner by the hand and foot. Usually about a beginner being helped with every detail.

examples.japanese: {手取|てと}り{足取|あしと}り⟦{教|おし}える→教える：00526_oshieru⟧。
⟦{先輩|せんぱい}→先輩：01451_senpai⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{手取|てと}り{足取|あしと}り⟦{教|おし}えて→教える：00526_oshieru⟧⟦くれた→くれる：00724_kureru⟧。
examples.english: A senior colleague taught me everything step by step.

examples.japanese: ⟦{新人|しんじん}→新人：02500_shinjin⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧ころ⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧、⟦{上司|じょうし}→上司：03286_joushi⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{仕事|しごと}→仕事：00480_shigoto⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦やり{方|かた}→やり方：10532_yarikata⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{手取|てと}り{足取|あしと}り⟦{教|おし}えて→教える：00526_oshieru⟧⟦もらった→もらう：00520_morau⟧。
examples.english: When I was new, my boss showed me exactly how to do the job, step by step.

notes:
Almost always followed by ⟦{教|おし}える→教える：00526_oshieru⟧ or ⟦{指導|しどう}→指導：03190_shidou⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧. It can carry a hint of criticism when the person should be able to manage alone: ⟦いつ→いつ：00536_itsu⟧⟦まで→まで：00490_made⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧{手取|てと}り{足取|あしと}り⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦だめ→だめ：00693_dame⟧だ (you can't be spoon-fed forever).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {手取|てと}り{足取|あしと}り⟦{教|おし}える→教える：00526_oshieru⟧: to teach every step
- {手取|てと}り{足取|あしと}り⟦{指導|しどう}→指導：03190_shidou⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to coach in detail

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{丁寧|ていねい}→丁寧：00896_teinei⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧: carefully, politely — the general word, without the hand-holding image
